note: Factors for the eco audit. Each is a typical range (low, high) with its source in data/sources.json. Energy is primary energy.
gridMjNote: Primary energy per kWh of electricity delivered: 3.6 MJ divided by a generation and grid efficiency of 35 to 45 %.

processes.name: Casting (metals)
processes.note: Melting, holding and pouring per kilogram of good casting.

processes.name: Rolling or forging (metals)
processes.note: Hot or cold deformation per kilogram.

processes.name: Extrusion (metals)
processes.note: Billet heating and extrusion per kilogram.

processes.name: Sheet forming and stamping
processes.note: Press forming per kilogram of part.

processes.name: Injection moulding (polymers)
processes.note: Including drying, heating and auxiliaries, per kilogram moulded.

processes.name: Composite lay-up and cure
processes.note: Hand or automated lay-up with oven or autoclave cure.

processes.name: Glass forming
processes.note: Shaping after melting (melting is in the material's own energy).

processes.name: Additive: powder-bed fusion (metals)
processes.note: Laser or electron-beam melting per kilogram built. Very variable with machine and fill.

machining.name: Machining (per kg removed)
machining.note: Turning and milling, including the machine's base load; per kilogram of material removed.

vehicles.name: Car, petrol
vehicles.note: Fuel energy per tonne of vehicle mass per km (about 6.5 litres per 100 km for a 1.3 tonne car); fuel CO₂ from the government factors.

vehicles.name: Car, diesel
vehicles.note: As petrol, with diesel's lower consumption.

vehicles.name: Car, electric
vehicles.note: Electricity per tonne·km (about 17 kWh per 100 km for a 1.8 tonne car); energy and CO₂ follow the grid chosen.

vehicles.name: Aircraft
vehicles.note: Fuel per tonne of aircraft mass per km, long haul.

eol.note: Recycling credits the energy and CO₂ saved against primary production, for the share collected; downcycling credits a small share of the primary energy (it replaces low-grade material); combustion credits the heat recovered at the efficiency shown and charges the CO₂ released; landfill charges collection and handling.
